quick_skim.title: OmniRay: Camera-Agnostic Monocular 3D Reconstruction with Composite Ray Fields
quick_skim.abstract: Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. Camera-aware models remove this assumption by predicting a per-pixel ray field. However, they represent different camera geometries using a single fixed basis to capture both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that camera geometry can be viewed as having a hierarchy of complexity for representing rays. We present OmniRay, a feed-forward model whose Ray Module is composed of three components: a monotone radial base that captures radially symmetric structure, a spherical-harmonic residual for smooth deviations from it, and a free-form residual for remaining local variation. These components are composed as successive rotations on the sphere, allowing the representation to accommodate diverse camera geometries. Given a single image, OmniRay predicts a ray direction and an up-to-scale radial distance for every pixel, from which a 3D point cloud is recovered without needing camera information at inference time. Extensive experiments across different camera configurations demonstrate that OmniRay establishes a new state-of-the-art in camera-agnostic monocular 3D reconstruction.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: OmniRay is a feed-forward monocular reconstruction model whose hierarchical ray module combines a monotone radial base with spherical-harmonic residuals to recover correct geometry from fisheye and panoramic imagery.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 现有单目三维重建模型多假设针孔相机，在鱼眼与全景等广角图像上会产生畸变几何，而相机感知模型又用单一固定基同时表达整体投影与细微变化。作者提出OmniRay，将相机几何视为具有层次复杂度的射线表示，其射线模块由单调径向基、球谐残差等三部分组成，前馈式地从单幅图像预测逐像素射线场与几何。实验表明该分层射线表示能更准确地恢复广角图像的三维结构，提升单目重建的相机泛化能力。
quick_skim.llm_tldr: 现有单目三维重建模型多假设针孔相机，在鱼眼与全景等广角图像上会产生畸变几何，而相机感知模型又用单一固定基同时表达整体投影与细微变化。作者提出OmniRay，将相机几何视为具有层次复杂度的射线表示，其射线模块由单调径向基、球谐残差等三部分组成，前馈式地从单幅图像预测逐像素射线场与几何。实验表明该分层射线表示能更准确地恢复广角图像的三维结构，提升单目重建的相机泛化能力。
